version.author: Andrew Dihtiaruk
version.changelog: - Added Backspace as a keyboard shortcut to reset the loop to the full source length. - Added the Segments control with Off, 1/1, 1/2, 1/4, and 1/8 divisions. - Added support for sending ideas, bug reports, and error logs to the developer. - Improved visual appearance with added colors and buttons.

version.author: Andrew Dihtiaruk
version.changelog: - Fixed the issue where the script opened with an extremely small window size. The first-open size is now 1663 Г— 369. - Added complete script closing with the Esc key. - Added loop navigation with arrow keys: Up moves right, and Down moves left by one loop length. - Added the Help menu with control and shortcut documentation.

version.author: Andrew Dihtiaruk
version.changelog: Fixed installation path: the script is now installed directly in the Utilities folder.
